_doc: T.M5 (proof:subject-legible + proof:subject-full) — the quality oracles replacing existence proxies. `legible` subjects assert no-blur-over-glyph + an edge-energy floor (retiring proof:icon-paint-live (a)'s bbox-only clause — a blur-filtered icon still has a non-zero box, #4). `full` subjects assert a RENDERED-REGION (all six cube faces, a visible filled morph shape over the grid) not an attribute read (subject-animates certifies '≥3 distinct transforms' — a single die-face that tilts passes, #1; morph-scene reads the d-attr mutation on a possibly-invisible path, #21). Each subject's `verified` is false until the browser render check passes on the CURED render — BORN-RED against today's defects (the blurred dock icon, the one-face cube, the bare-grid morph). The band that cures the defect flips `verified` WITH the browser oracle.
